title: Neon Valkyries: Anime Idle RPG
shortDescription: Epic Anime Idle RPG! Collect cyber waifus, enjoy Live2D & 7x7 tactical battles.
fullDescription:
Redefining the Cyberpunk Anime Strategy RPG!

Step into the unknown in this futuristic cyberpunk world and begin your legendary journey. Over a hundred unique and beautifully illustrated cyber girls are waiting for your summon. We’ve perfectly combined chill, no-grind idle mechanics with hardcore 7x7 grid tactical battles, bringing you an unprecedented visual and strategic feast!

🎮 Why Players Love Us:

✨ Massive Waifu Collection & Fully Animated Live2D

Ultimate Visual Experience: Say goodbye to lifeless 2D sprites! Every goddess card you pull features high-quality, fully dynamic Live2D animations, capturing every breath and heartbeat.

Exclusive Romance & Intimacy: A unique dating-sim intimacy system. Increase your bond to unlock exclusive hidden storylines and interactive voice lines for every character, fully voiced by a top-tier cast.

⚔️ 7x7 Grid Tactics & Hardcore Strategy

No More Brainless Stat Checks: Our unique 7x7 grid battlefield demands true tactical skill. Precise positioning—front, back, left, and right—directly impacts your waifus' roles, skill coverage, and survivability in combat.

Infinite Team Synergies: Say goodbye to boring, repetitive daily grinds. Focus your energy on core team building and tower climbing. Mix and match characters from different factions and classes to trigger exclusive team bonds and buffs. Use your wits to turn the tide of battle!

📖 Immersive Storyline & Cyberpunk World Exploration

Dive into a grand, epic main storyline. Plus, every deployed waifu has her own personal biography and intimacy trial quests waiting to be unlocked.

💎 True Player-First Experience: 100% F2P Friendly

Generous & Transparent Gacha: Enjoy high SSR drop rates and a fully transparent "pity" system, guaranteeing you won't miss out on your favorite limited banners.

Collect With Ease: Abundant in-game events and high drop rates for free base characters make this a paradise for gacha collectors and completionists.

Zero Paywalls: All main story content and core PvP arena rewards are completely free and accessible to everyone. Your strategy and skills are your only passport to victory!
